_headers: Set by the connector on every request to this origin. The program can neither set them — it is refused by name if it tries — nor read them back. GitHub refuses a request carrying no user-agent, so the program does not work without this line, and does not contain it. Swap `user-agent` for `authorization` and the credential lives here, in the deployment, rather than in the code that spends it.
_allow_headers: When present, the exhaustive set of header names the program MAY set on this origin. Absent would mean anything not reserved.
_omits: example: omits budget, which a real deployment states; 06-budgets is the one that shows it.
